info.name: Kiteworks API Documentation activities groups API

params.name: name
params.description: Filter results by the exact group name.

params.name: name:contains
params.description: Filter results to groups whose names contain the specified characters.

params.name: orderBy
params.description:
Sort order for the results. Default is `name:asc`.
Allowed values: `id:asc`, `id:desc`, `name:asc`, `name:desc`.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of groups to return.

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of groups to skip before returning results, for pagination.

items.docs:
### Description:
  Returns the list of Kiteworks groups for the current user, including the email address of each member in the group.
### Precondition:
  User must be authenticated.
### Response:
  Returns the list of groups.

### Description:
  Creates a new Kiteworks group of users.
### Precondition:
  User must be authenticated.
### Response:
  Returns the newly created group.
